Derived work shipped in PatchTrace: src/patchtrace/unified/ir/mdindex.py (Python, MIT-licensed project code with an
Apache-2.0 attribution header). It re-expresses graph_util.h `CalculateMdIndexInternal`, the flow-graph MD index
(flow_graph.cc) and the call-graph vertex MD index (call_graph.cc): the edge value 1/(sqrt(2)*in(s) + sqrt(3)*out(s) +
sqrt(5)*in(t) + sqrt(7)*out(t) + sqrt(11)*lvl(s) + sqrt(13)*lvl(t)), breadth-first levels, the ascending sort and plain
left-to-right double accumulation, and the documented level-0 quirks. Changes: language (C++ to Python), data structures
(integer vertex ids and adjacency lists instead of BinDiff graph classes), a quirk switch, and integer-scaled keys. The
port was checked bit-for-bit against an independent C++ transcription compiled in a throwaway directory (a 3,000-graph
random comparison, docs/qa.md; five recorded vectors are pinned in tests/test_unified_ir_graph.py). It was NOT checked
against the real `bindiff --md_index` output (no pinned BinDiff binary). No GPL or yFiles code is involved; "BinDiff" is
a trademark of Google LLC and the unified engine never claims to be BinDiff.

Redistribution: both build scripts (tools/build_windows.py, tools/build_linux.py) refuse to publish a distribution
without LICENSE and this record, and copy them under licenses/upstream/.
